pr_body:
If a remote cluster has the skip_unavailable option set and is
unavailable during a datafeed search then we should retry rather
than risk using incomplete search results. Using incomplete search
results could lead to spurious anomalies being found that do not
make sense once the remote cluster is available once again.

Fixes #83838
pr_title: [ML] Retry datafeed searches on skipped CCS clusters
pr_comment: Hi @droberts195, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

review_comment:
This test often passes, and proves the code changes work.

However, the PR cannot be merged as-is because sometimes this test fails as follows:

```
java.lang.AssertionError: 
Expected: <0>
     but: was <300>
Expected :<0>
Actual   :<300>

	at __randomizedtesting.SeedInfo.seed([41E6F5EF31368549:15BE9EBA233BDCEA]:0)
	at org.hamcrest.MatcherAssert.assertThat(MatcherAssert.java:18)
	at org.junit.Assert.assertThat(Assert.java:956)
	at org.junit.Assert.assertThat(Assert.java:923)
	at org.elasticsearch.test.InternalTestCluster.lambda$assertSearchContextsReleased$44(InternalTestCluster.java:2529)
	at org.elasticsearch.test.ESTestCase.assertBusy(ESTestCase.java:1068)
	at org.elasticsearch.test.ESTestCase.assertBusy(ESTestCase.java:1041)
	at org.elasticsearch.test.InternalTestCluster.assertSearchContextsReleased(InternalTestCluster.java:2528)
	at org.elasticsearch.test.InternalTestCluster.assertAfterTest(InternalTestCluster.java:2470)
	at org.elasticsearch.test.AbstractMultiClustersTestCase.assertAfterTest(AbstractMultiClustersTestCase.java:139)
	at java.base/jdk.internal.reflect.NativeMethodAccessorImpl.invoke0(Native Method)
	at java.base/jdk.internal.reflect.NativeMethodAccessorImpl.invoke(NativeMethodAccessorImpl.java:77)
	at java.base/jdk.internal.reflect.DelegatingMethodAccessorImpl.invoke(DelegatingMethodAccessorImpl.java:43)
	at java.base/java.lang.reflect.Method.invoke(Method.java:568)
```

The post-test assertions sometimes find unreleased search contexts.  So there must be somewhere in the datafeed code that doesn't release search contexts if a search fails.

In addition there are a couple of outstanding TODOs in this test, but I thought I'd push the code in its current form for visibility.
I think the issue is that we need to clear scroll if the search response contains skipped clusters.

I removed the `indices.contains(null)` bit because `contains(null)` called on a `List` created with `List.of` throws an NPE.  I don't think it's possible for an end user to specify `null` as a list element now that they cannot use the transport client because the X-Content parser won't accept `null` elements.  So I think the check is now redundant and just annoying for test code that wants to use `List.of`.
